LandingPage_Section_Scope_Description: NIYOJAN ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਸੁਆਗਤ ਹੈ, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਤਾਲਮੇਲ ਸਪਸ਼ਟਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ। NGO ਟੀਮਾਂ ਰਜਿਸਟਰ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਸਿੰਗਲ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿਤ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ ਨਾਲ ਕੰਮ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
LandingPage_FAQ_Description: Common questions about how NIYOJAN works and who it is for.
LandingPage_FAQ_Q1_Answer: NIYOJAN is an operations platform for NGO coordination. It handles document intake, form-based survey collection, AI-assisted need extraction, volunteer matching by skills and location, assignment tracking, and field feedback closure. It does not dispatch emergency services or manage funds.
LandingPage_FAQ_Q2_Answer: NGO administrators, field workers, and volunteers. Superadmins oversee the full pipeline; NGO teams manage forms and surveys; volunteers receive assignments and submit field feedback.
LandingPage_FAQ_Q3_Answer: The frontend UI is available in English and 15 Indian languages: Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi, Tamil, Urdu, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Punjabi, Assamese, Maithili, Santali, and Kashmiri.
LandingPage_FAQ_Q4_Answer: Matching uses weighted scoring based on skill relevance, geographic distance, and availability. Volunteers are ranked against each need. The system is deterministic and does not use real-time location tracking.
LandingPage_FAQ_Q5_Question: How does an NGO get started?
LandingPage_FAQ_Q5_Answer: Register your organization through the signup page. After email verification, a superadmin reviews and approves the account. Once approved, your team can create form templates, launch surveys, and manage field operations.
LandingPage_FAQ_Q6_Answer: The platform is currently in prototype phase. There is no billing system. Terms of use and any future pricing will be communicated as the project matures.
